name: CannyECM
description_en: The original CannyDocs entry now redirects to CannyECM, CannyMinds’ enterprise document and workflow product. Evaluate it for organizing digital records, finding scanned content and controlling revisions or approvals. CannyScan handles a separate capture and quality-control stage; physical-record and HR products have their own scope. Current commercial amounts and historical CannyDocs entitlement continuity remain unverified.
description_zh: 原 CannyDocs 入口现跳转至 CannyMinds 的企业文档与工作流产品 CannyECM。可针对数字记录整理、扫描内容检索及修订审批控制进行评估。CannyScan 承担独立的采集与质检阶段，实体记录及 HR 产品也有各自范围。当前费用金额与历史 CannyDocs 权益连续性仍未核实。

sections.title_zh: 按当前 CannyECM 入口评估
sections.en:
Opening the assigned CannyDocs URL in the browser redirects to CannyECM. This establishes the current destination, but does not show how an old customer’s contract, database or license migrates. Keep the distinction explicit when evaluating an existing installation.

The product offer covers browser-based document management with OCR search, versioning, permissions and approval workflows. For an editorial pilot, use a synthetic supplier certificate with a supplier ID, expiry date, owner and review status. First decide whether the task is finding a file, approving its use or tracking a physical original. Those tasks require different acceptance evidence; a successful search does not establish approval or physical custody. This research did not create a repository or inspect a customer installation.
sections.zh:
在浏览器打开分配的 CannyDocs URL 会跳转至 CannyECM。这确立当前目标页面，但不说明旧客户合同、数据库或许可如何迁移。评估既有安装时需明确区分。

产品方案涵盖基于浏览器的文档管理，以及 OCR 检索、版本、权限和审批流程。编辑建议的试点可用一份虚构供应商证书，设置供应商标识、到期日、负责人及审查状态。先确定任务是找到文件、批准使用，还是跟踪实体原件；三者需要不同验收证据。检索成功不确立审批或实体保管。本研究未创建资料库或检查客户安装。

sections.title_en: Keep scanning acceptance separate from repository acceptance
sections.title_zh: 把扫描验收与资料库验收分开
sections.en:
CannyScan is a separate capture offering connected to CannyECM. Its documented flow inventories and batches records, scans them, checks quality, assigns indexes, extracts content, performs final quality review and exports to the DMS. Rejected scans can return for re-scanning with comments. Its reporting distinguishes exported from not-yet-exported records.

For the proposed certificate, include a faint expiry date and a deliberately rotated page. Compare extracted values with the source image, reject an incorrect result and verify that the accepted file and metadata reach the intended repository record. Check the pending/export report rather than equating a completed scan batch with complete ingestion. These are proposed tests only. No accuracy percentage, processing rate or ability to discard original paper was validated; a vendor’s legal summary is not a determination for the user’s records.
sections.zh:
CannyScan 是连接 CannyECM 的独立采集方案。文档流程包括清点分批、扫描、质量检查、索引分配、内容提取、最终质检及导出至 DMS。未通过的扫描可带评论退回重扫；报告区分已导出与尚未导出记录。

建议证书样例可包含模糊到期日及刻意旋转的一页。将提取值与原图比较，拒绝错误结果，再确认获接受文件及元数据进入正确资料库记录。应检查待导出报告，不能把扫描批次完成等同于全部导入完成。这些仅为建议测试。未验证准确率、处理速度或销毁原纸资格；厂商法律概述不能代替用户记录的具体判断。

sections.title_en: An approved drawing and an editable file serve different roles
sections.title_zh: 已批准图纸与可编辑文件承担不同角色
sections.en:
The manufacturing document-control page describes drawing revisions, review/approval, department access and an approved-version view. Its SOP workflow includes effective dates, periodic review and training acknowledgment. These are document-governance claims; format compatibility does not establish CAD authoring or an operating training assessment.

For the certificate example, adapt that control problem to a renewal: retain the currently authorized record while a proposed replacement is reviewed, then inspect which version each role can see. Add a reader outside the owning department and an expired document to the evaluation. Confirm whether acknowledgment applies to the required version and what happens when review is rejected or overdue. Exact rejection routing, version locking and reminder/escalation behavior need a configured demonstration. No workflow or regulated-compliance validation was performed.
sections.zh:
制造业文档控制页描述图纸修订、审查批准、部门访问及已批准版本视图；SOP 流程还包括生效日期、定期复审和培训确认。这些是文档治理主张，格式兼容不确立 CAD 编写或实际培训能力考核。

在证书示例中可转化为续期问题：替换文件审查期间保留当前授权记录，再检查各角色看到哪个版本。评估还应加入所属部门之外的读者及已过期文件，核对确认是否对应所需版本、拒绝或逾期时如何处理。精确拒绝路由、版本锁定及提醒升级行为需配置演示。本研究未执行工作流或受监管合规验证。

sections.title_en: A trial contact link is not an activated deployment
sections.title_zh: 试用联系入口不等于已开通部署
sections.en:
CannyECM advertises cloud, on-premise and hybrid options and a 30-day trial without a credit card. The actual trial link leads to the general contact form. Public reading did not establish immediate self-service activation, paid amounts, billing units, renewal, refunds or trial-data retention. On-premise wording about no recurring cloud fees does not mean no software, support or infrastructure cost.

For the pilot, request the current supported installation specification and quote appropriate to the intended topology, document volume and operators. Check backup ownership, restoration evidence and version-support obligations rather than using broad capacity or uptime claims as acceptance. The public technical table includes older runtime and infrastructure versions; suitability for a new supported deployment remains unresolved. No contact form was submitted or software installed.
sections.zh:
CannyECM 宣传云端、本地及混合方案，以及无需信用卡的 30 天试用。实际试用链接进入通用联系表单。公开阅读未确立即时自助开通、付费金额、计费单位、续期、退款或试用数据保留。本地方案所谓无周期性云费用，不等于没有软件、支持或基础设施成本。

试点应取得适合目标拓扑、文档量和操作人员的当前受支持安装规格与报价。应检查备份责任、恢复证据及版本支持义务，不能以笼统容量或在线率主张代替验收。公开技术表包含较旧运行时及基础设施版本，是否适合新建受支持部署仍未确立。本研究未提交联系表单或安装软件。

sections.title_en: Software ownership and availability need the applicable contract
sections.title_zh: 软件权利与服务可用性需看适用合同
sections.en:
The company terms reserve intellectual property in its software and prohibit unauthorized reproduction or distribution. They do not grant an open-source license; local installation alone does not change that. The same terms describe 99.9% uptime as an aim and explicitly do not guarantee uninterrupted access, while the product page uses stronger guarantee language. A purchase needs the applicable service commitment and remedies.

For an existing CannyDocs user, establish the actual licensed edition and support agreement before treating the redirected page as a migration promise. For a new evaluation, ask for the agreement that covers users, guests, deployment, updates, exit and backups. Certification logos, encryption descriptions and links to standards bodies do not independently establish that a particular installation meets the user’s obligations. This profile is documentation research, not a security or legal audit.
sections.zh:
公司条款保留软件知识产权，禁止未经授权复制或分发，没有授予开源许可；本地安装本身不改变这一点。同一条款把 99.9% 在线率描述为努力目标，并明确不保证访问不中断，而产品页采用更强的保证措辞。采购需核对适用服务承诺与救济。

既有 CannyDocs 用户应先明确实际许可版本及支持协议，再判断跳转页面是否构成迁移承诺。新评估则应取得涵盖用户、访客、部署、更新、退出和备份的协议。认证标识、加密说明及标准组织链接不独立证明具体安装满足用户义务。本档案属于文档研究，未执行安全或法律审计。

sections.title_en: A personal-data policy is not a document-retention schedule
sections.title_zh: 个人信息政策不等于业务文档保留表
sections.en:
The privacy notice covers contact and business information, usage analytics and correspondence. It permits service-provider processing and describes retention by purpose, with legal or legitimate-business exceptions, rather than a fixed deletion deadline. It offers requests for access, correction, deletion and applicable portability.

For the certificate pilot, separate a contact inquiry from uploaded business records and infrastructure logs. Establish the processors, storage region, tenant export contents and treatment of deleted files in the chosen deployment. The general notice does not specify the complete business-document retention, trash purge or restore process. No deletion request, export or restore was made. A successful document download would not by itself demonstrate recovery of workflow states, permissions and audit history.
sections.zh:
隐私通知涵盖联系与业务信息、使用分析及通信记录，允许服务提供方处理，按目的保留，并设法律或正当业务例外，没有固定删除期限；还提供访问、更正、删除及适用的数据可携请求。

证书试点应区分联系询问、上传业务记录与基础设施日志，明确选定部署的处理方、存储地区、租户导出内容及已删文件处理方式。通用通知没有说明完整业务文档保留、回收站清理或恢复流程。本研究未提出删除请求、导出或恢复。成功下载文档本身，也不证明可恢复工作流状态、权限和审计历史。
